title: Quality Gate Panel
description: Build the PRISM Quality Gate panel for hyperMILL. Provides per-operation surface integrity predictions (Ra, residual stress, white layer risk), collision pre-check status (PRISM runs before hyperMILL simulation), setup sheet preview with physics-backed warnings, and FAI (First Article Inspection) plan generation button. Targets aerospace/defense shops where surface integrity is flight-critical.

forge_triple.hook: hm-plugin:quality-gate-blocking — BUILT (blocks NC output if white layer risk > threshold)
forge_triple.action: hypermill_plugin:get_quality_assessment — BUILT (returns surface integrity + collision status)
forge_triple.skill: /hypermill-quality-gate — BUILT (full quality assessment for active operation)

sessions.title: Surface Integrity + Collision Pre-Check
sessions.intent: Wire surface integrity engines (residual stress, white layer, Ra prediction) and collision prevention to a quality assessment action, then build the HTML/JS panel with traffic-light status indicators.

units.title: Surface Integrity Assessment Action
units.description: Create hypermill_plugin:get_quality_assessment action. Wire ResidualStressPredictionEngine for tensile/compressive stress prediction, WhiteLayerDetectionEngine for thermal damage risk, SurfaceFinishPredictorEngine for Ra/Rz prediction. Returns traffic-light status (green/yellow/red) per metric with explanation text. Red = blocking for aerospace parts.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Residual stress output includes tensile/compressive classification with magnitude in MPa
White layer risk returns probability 0-1 with blocking threshold at 0.3 for aerospace
Ra prediction within 15% of theoretical value for known tool nose radius + feed combos

units.title: Collision Pre-Check Integration
units.description: Wire CollisionPreventionEngine to run PRISM's collision check before hyperMILL's built-in simulation. Check tool assembly (holder + tool) against stock model, fixture, and machine envelope. Returns collision zones with XYZ coordinates and severity. Faster than full hyperMILL VIRTUAL Machining simulation for quick pre-screening.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Collision check runs in <2 seconds for typical 3-axis operation
Returns collision zone coordinates (X, Y, Z) with severity (warning/critical)
Integrates holder geometry from tool assembly for realistic collision detection

sessions.exit_gate: Surface integrity + collision actions return valid data for 3 test materials | omega_floor >= 0.90

sessions.title: Quality Panel UI + FAI Generation
sessions.intent: Build the Quality Gate HTML/JS panel with traffic-light indicators and add FAI plan generation and setup sheet preview capabilities.

units.title: Quality Gate Panel HTML/JS UI
units.description: Build the Quality Gate panel with: traffic-light grid (Ra, residual stress, white layer, collision — each green/yellow/red), expandable detail cards per metric, setup sheet preview with physics-backed warning annotations, and overall quality score as percentage. Panel updates in real-time as user navigates operations in hyperMILL's job list.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Traffic-light grid shows 4 metrics with color-coded status and hover tooltips
Detail cards expand to show numerical values, thresholds, and recommendations
Panel auto-refreshes when user selects a different operation in hyperMILL job list

units.title: FAI Plan Generation + Setup Sheet Preview
units.description: Wire FAIEngine to generate AS9102 First Article Inspection plans from the current job's operations. Wire SetupSheetEngine to produce setup sheet previews with physics-backed annotations (force arrows, deflection zones, critical dimensions). Add 'Generate FAI Plan' and 'Preview Setup Sheet' buttons to the Quality Gate panel.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: FAI plan generates AS9102-compliant form with balloon numbers mapped to operations
Setup sheet preview includes tool list, WCS diagram, and physics warning annotations
Both outputs exportable as PDF from within the panel

sessions.exit_gate: Quality panel shows traffic lights + FAI generates AS9102 output + setup sheet renders | omega_floor >= 0.90

units.title: HM-PLG-MS3 — Coordinator
units.description: Master coordinator envelope for HM-PLG-MS3. Tracks sub-milestones, aggregates their exit gates, and opens closure after every child milestone flips to complete. Follow 4-LOOP at the aggregation layer.
